QuestInfo.name: The Dark Lord's Trivial Problem 1
QuestInfo.0: The Dark Lord says that a small problem has risen. His expression seems to indicate that he is quite bothered. Go see the Dark Lord.
QuestInfo.1: The Dark Lord says that some strange incidents have occurred recently. Although they are not serious, the frequency of the occurrences bothers him.\r\nOne incident involves the thieving #b#o120100##k who have infiltrated Victoria Island. He needs someone to get rid of them by investigating each one, but there is no one the Dark Lord can trust with the task. In order to gain the Dark Lord's trust, you volunteer to eliminate the #b#o120100##k...
QuestInfo.2:
The Dark Lord said that a few strange incidents occurred recently. Although they were not serious, the frequency of the occurrences bothered him.
One incident involved the thieving #b#o120100##k who infiltrated Victoria Island. He needed someone to get rid of them by investigating each one, so you volunteered for the task...

Although you eliminated 20 #b#o120100##k, you were unable to find a suspicious #b#o120100##k. Still, the Dark Lord appreciated your hard work, and you seemed to have successfully gained his trust.
QuestInfo.summary: To solve the Dark Lord's problem, head to the #bSix Path Crossway#k located to the left of Kerning City and eliminate the #bSpores#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 200\nCan proceed to the 'Dark Lord's Trivial Problem 2' quest\n

0.0: What is it?\r\n#L0##bYou appear as if something is bothering you. Is there something you're worried about...?#l\n#k
0.1: No, nothing you need to worry about. If you don't need anything from me, you're free to leave.\r\n#L0##bI don't need anything, but I just thought we could chat a bit.#l\n#k
0.2: Heh, aren't you the peculiar one? Most people would rather talk to a tree than with me. Still, today is not a good day. So many little problems have been turning up in Kerning City these days. Those thieving Spores are especially giving me a headache.\r\n#L0##bI heard something about those thieving Spores too... From what I hear, they are making everyone miserable by stealing things and playing pranks.#l\n#k
0.3: Ah, so you're aware. Well, the stolen items are of negligible value, so that hasn't been too problematic. It's the pranks they're pulling on people that I'm worried about. They need to be stopped, but investigating every Spore in Victoria Island is out of the question... I'm not sure what to do. \r\n#L0##bWell, what if I took care of this for you? I don't have much to do right now, and I was planning on exploring Victoria Island anyway.#l\n#k
0.4: Hmm...really? This could be very time consuming... But if you really wish to help, I will entrust this job to you.

yes.0: First, investigate #b10 Spores#k. They may be hiding something. The thieving Spores should be hiding the mask that was used during the crimes. Spores have been appearing in large numbers at the #bSix Path Crossway#k, so head there first.

no.0: No one else thought this was too much to handle, but I guess you are different.

1.0: You've returned. So, were you able to find a suspicious Spore?\r\n#L0##bWell... Unfortunately, I didn't have much success.#l\n#k
1.1: Well, I didn't expect that he would be found very easily. In any case, thank you for helping me. You are much more trustworthy than I first thought.

yes.0: I will continue to trust you with tasks and ask for help when it's needed.

mob.0: First, catch #b10 Spores.#k They may be hiding something. The thieving Spore should be hiding a mask that was used during the crimes.
